expectations.text: Guides user to specific reference platforms (Mobbin, Dribbble, competitors)
expectations.evidence: Mentions Dribbble, Behance, and a few competitor apps but no specific search queries or systematic approach

expectations.text: Organizes references by category (pet apps, marketplace patterns, booking flows)
expectations.evidence: Lists references in a flat list without categorical organization or cross-domain pattern mapping

expectations.text: Identifies common visual patterns relevant to pet care marketplace
expectations.evidence: Gives generic UI advice (use cards, bright colors, clear CTAs) without pet-marketplace-specific pattern identification

expectations.text: Produces a structured design references deliverable or moodboard framework
expectations.evidence: No deliverable produced — just conversational suggestions about where to look

expectations.text: Establishes visual vocabulary that prevents blank-canvas paralysis
expectations.evidence: No visual vocabulary synthesis — user would still face blank canvas with scattered suggestions
